gitCommit.subject: Tests: a busy machine slows the waits, it does not fail them
gitCommit.body:
Tests: a busy machine slows the waits, it does not fail them

With another build loading the machine, four tests failed for time
alone (verifier's new issue): the application's "every other case"
test filled the form four times and ran out of its five seconds; the
one-key test, and the first render of the trial card and of the
console's trial, missed Testing Library's one-second wait.

- The "every other case" refusals are four tests, one form each.
- Each test that types the form has fifteen seconds.
- Those waits, and the first render the two trial files wait for, are
  given five seconds (SLOW_WAIT, in the shared harness).

Proof: the three files run on one CPU with three workers — the old
tests failed 4 and 5 of 83 in two runs (the same tests the verifier
saw fail), the new ones passed 86 of 86 twice.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
